findings.test: Target population documented
findings.inputs: METIMMOX_CEA_LancetOncol_v4.md (R01) 'Clinical data source'; CEA.qmd/.pdf Overview
findings.expected: Population is stated with enough detail to map to model inputs (disease, line of therapy, trial n, eligibility)
findings.observed: MSS/pMMR mCRC, first-line, METIMMOX IPD n=65 complete cases, eligibility criteria (unresectable, measurable infradiaphragmatic metastasis, PS 0-1) stated consistently in R01 and reflected in CEA.qmd overview.
findings.location: R01 Methods 'Clinical data source'; docs_extracted/CEA.txt Overview
findings.recommended_fix: None required.

findings.test: Relevant population subgroups documented consistently
findings.target: AGENTS.md vs docs/README.md vs manuscript vs CEA.qmd
findings.inputs: S01 AGENTS.md Biomarker Strategies section; S02 docs/README.md 'Biomarker Strategies Evaluated'; R01 manuscript Model A/B/C panel; docs_extracted/CEA.txt, input_parameters.txt
findings.expected: The set of biomarker subgroups the model can assess is stated once, clearly, and consistently across the documentation set
findings.observed: AGENTS.md and the currently-rendered CEA.qmd/input_parameters.qmd describe exactly two economic subgroups (CRP, TMB/BRAF) with TLR explicitly excluded as a post-randomization mediator. docs/README.md ('1 CRP, 2 TLR, 3 TMB/BRAF... three biomarkers') and the manuscript (TLR-guided strategy + enriched TLR population under Models A/C) describe a third, TLR-based economic subgroup that the current single-model report suite does not carry.
findings.location: S02 docs/README.md 'Biomarker Strategies Evaluated'; R01 Methods panel; docs_extracted/input_parameters.txt Table 1
findings.recommended_fix: Mark docs/README.md and/or the manuscript's TLR-strategy/Model-A-C material as superseded or historical, and state explicitly in one canonical location (e.g. a top-of-README banner) which subgroup set the currently deployed model evaluates.

findings.test: Comparators represented consistently
findings.target: AGENTS.md / model_configs.R description vs docs/README.md vs manuscript
findings.inputs: S01 AGENTS.md 'no model-structure switch or multi-structure comparison layer'; S02 docs/README.md 'Multi-model structure comparison (Model A/B/C)'; R01 Model A/B/C panel; docs_extracted/CEA.txt Table 2
findings.expected: Comparators (standard of care vs each biomarker-guided strategy) are stated once and match the actually-reported analysis
findings.observed: CEA.qmd/input_parameters.qmd unambiguously state 3 arms: standard of care, CRP-guided, TMB/BRAF-guided. README.md advertises a fourth arm (TLR-guided) and a Model A/B/C structural-comparison feature; the manuscript documents all three specifications and a TLR arm as an active part of the analysis (Tables 4-6).
findings.location: S02 docs/README.md 'Key Features'; R01 Table 4-6; docs_extracted/CEA.txt Table 2
findings.recommended_fix: Same as TR-COMP-002: reconcile which comparator set is current, or clearly date/label the manuscript's broader Model A/B/C/TLR framework as a prior or exploratory analysis stage distinct from the deployed single-model code.

findings.test: Cost categories match stated perspective
findings.inputs: R01 'Economic evaluation' paragraph; docs_extracted/input_parameters.txt Table 4; S01 AGENTS.md parameter table
findings.expected: Documented cost categories are consistent with the stated analytic perspective
findings.observed: 'Extended healthcare perspective consistent with Norwegian HTA guidelines' is stated in R01; cost categories (nivolumab, FLOX, CT, blood, NGS, visit, baseline, follow-up, end-of-life) are itemized with base-case values and DSA ranges in input_parameters.qmd Table 4 and manuscript Table 1, consistent with a healthcare-payer perspective.
findings.recommended_fix: None required; optionally state explicitly which cost categories (e.g. productivity/indirect costs) are out of scope for the 'extended' perspective.

findings.test: Clinician/patient-important outcomes represented
findings.inputs: docs_extracted/CEA.txt (QALYs, cost, ICER, NMB); docs_extracted/clinical_effectiveness.txt; R01 Table 4; grep for adverse/toxicity/safety across all extracted docs and AGENTS.md
findings.expected: Outcomes meaningful to clinicians and patients (survival, QALYs, and typically adverse events/toxicity for an immunotherapy regimen) are documented
findings.observed: QALYs, life-years, cost, ICER, NMB, and CEAC are consistently documented, and OS/PFS survival curves are covered in clinical_effectiveness.qmd/para_models.qmd. No adverse-event or toxicity outcome or cost category appears anywhere in the reviewed documentation, and no rationale for excluding immune-related or chemotherapy-related AEs from the economic model is stated.
findings.location: docs_extracted/input_parameters.txt Table 4 (cost categories, no AE line item); docs_extracted/CEA.txt Table 3-4
findings.recommended_fix: Add a brief statement of scope explaining whether adverse-event costs/disutilities were considered and, if excluded, why (e.g. data limitations in the n=65 trial).

findings.test: CHAOS: Starting point / README rubric
findings.inputs: S02 docs/README.md full text
findings.expected: README states model goal/purpose, developer contact, publication link/DOI, and installation guidance in detail (Advanced tier)
findings.observed: Goal/purpose, publication/related-trial DOIs, and installation guidance (clone + pacman::p_load) are all present in detail. Developer contact is limited to a bare GitHub username; the manuscript's correspondence email is a '[email]' placeholder. The README's own description of the model (three biomarkers, Model A/B/C multi-structure comparison) materially disagrees with the canonical AGENTS.md and the rendered reports, which undermines the 'described in detail' quality bar even though the four required bullet items are nominally present.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a real contact email/ORCID, and update the README's model description to match the current deployed model (2-biomarker single joint model) to reach Advanced.

findings.test: CHAOS: Run guidance rubric
findings.inputs: S01 AGENTS.md 'Essential Commands'/'Complete Analysis & Reporting Workflow'; S02 docs/README.md 'Usage'
findings.expected: Starting file/code, inputs list, function workflow, output generation, and runtime (if >1 min) are all described in detail, ideally in the README
findings.observed: AGENTS.md documents all five elements in detail, including specific runtime warnings for scripts 08/12/14. docs/README.md's own Usage section covers starting file, inputs, and outputs but omits scripts 10b/14b/15 and specific long-runtime warnings for 12/14 (only a generic 'may take significant time' note). A reader confined to README alone gets an Adequate, not Advanced, picture; combined with AGENTS.md the guidance is Advanced.
findings.recommended_fix: Optionally fold AGENTS.md's more complete runtime/script-11-15 guidance into docs/README.md so the single most-discoverable file is self-sufficient.

findings.test: CHAOS: License rubric
findings.inputs: S04 LICENSE (MIT); S02 docs/README.md License section; R01 Data sharing section
findings.expected: An open license (MIT/Apache/BSD/GPL) is present and referenced
findings.observed: MIT License present at repo root, correctly referenced from README and from the manuscript's Data sharing statement.
findings.recommended_fix: None required.

findings.test: CHAOS: Package & dependencies rubric
findings.inputs: S02 docs/README.md 'Prerequisites'; S01 AGENTS.md 'Package Installation'; environment.md package table
findings.expected: Packages are listed with version details and a dependency-description file, ideally a lockfile
findings.observed: Packages are listed by name only (via pacman::p_load prose blocks) with no version numbers, no DESCRIPTION file, and no renv.lock. environment.md independently confirms all 36 detected packages are 'undeclared' against any manifest.
findings.recommended_fix: Add an renv.lock (or minimally a DESCRIPTION-style versioned package table) to reach at least Adequate.

findings.test: CHAOS: Model version (history) rubric
findings.inputs: docs_extracted/bug_fix_impact.txt; docs_extracted/model_b_comparison.txt; report footers across R02-R14
findings.expected: Versions/releases and their change descriptions are documented, ideally via repo release functionality or a semver changelog
findings.observed: Per-document 'Report version' footers (e.g. CEA.qmd v4.0, model_b_comparison.qmd v2.2) plus eight issue-numbered 'CopyOf...' technical-doc PDFs and a narrative 'Original vs Current Model B' redesign document together describe versions with change rationale (Adequate). No unified changelog/semver scheme exists; the model subdirectory itself is not under version control per environment.md; and the currently-rendered bug_fix_impact.qmd reports 'No snapshot files were found', i.e. the live change-tracking artifact is presently empty.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a single top-level CHANGELOG.md summarizing issue-numbered changes with semantic version tags, and re-run 15_save_snapshot.R so bug_fix_impact.qmd has current comparison content.

findings.test: AdViSHE A1: conceptual model reviewed by qualified experts
findings.inputs: R01 'Contributors' section; full-text search for 'expert'/'review panel' across AGENTS.md and all extracted reports
findings.expected: Documentation records whether qualified experts reviewed the conceptual model, who they were, and whether they agreed
findings.observed: No named expert panel, review criteria, or agreement statement is documented. The manuscript's Contributors section (which would name the clinical co-authors' roles) is marked '[To be completed]'.
findings.recommended_fix: Complete the Contributors section identifying which co-authors reviewed the conceptual model/decision-analytic structure and whether they concurred, or add a short 'Conceptual model validation' subsection stating this was not formally performed.

findings.test: AdViSHE A2: conceptual model compared with other models/textbook descriptions
findings.inputs: R01 'Research in context: Evidence before this study'; refs 27-28
findings.expected: Documentation records whether the conceptual model was compared with other models or clinical-textbook descriptions and where
findings.observed: A systematic literature search is reported establishing novelty (no prior CEAs of biomarker-guided ICB in MSS mCRC found); other mCRC economic/survival models are cited (refs 27, 28) as cost/data sources, not as an explicit structural comparison of conceptual model design.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a short paragraph explicitly comparing the 3-state PSM structure against comparable published mCRC models (e.g., refs 27-28) rather than citing them only as parameter sources.

findings.test: AdViSHE B1: input data reviewed by qualified experts
findings.inputs: R01 'Clinical data source'; full-text search for independent data review
findings.expected: Documentation records whether qualified experts independently reviewed the input data and agreed with the choices made
findings.observed: No independent input-data review process is documented; data provenance (METIMMOX trial co-investigators) is described but not an independent review/sign-off step.
findings.recommended_fix: Document whether any co-author independent of the primary modeler reviewed input-data extraction/coding decisions, or state this was not performed.

findings.test: AdViSHE B2: statistical fit tests for regression-derived inputs
findings.inputs: docs_extracted/para_models.txt Table 2-3 (AIC/BIC across 9 distributions per endpoint); docs_extracted/all_parametric_survival_models (technical doc)
findings.expected: Documentation records whether fit tests were performed for regression-derived inputs and where methods/results are reported
findings.observed: para_models.qmd reports AIC/BIC comparison across 9 candidate parametric distributions for both OS and PFS, selection rationale (gamma/lognormal by AIC), and a KM-overlay visual-fit reference (manuscript Fig 1 legend); a dedicated technical_docs/all_parametric_survival_models.qmd gives the full comparison for all specifications. Location is clear and findable.
findings.recommended_fix: None required.

findings.test: AdViSHE C1: implemented model reviewed by independent modelling experts
findings.inputs: Full-text search for 'independent review'/'code review'/'audit' across all reviewed materials
findings.expected: Documentation records whether modelling experts independently reviewed the implemented (coded) model and where unresolved issues are reported
findings.observed: No documentation of a prior independent code/model review or audit was found anywhere in the reviewed corpus.
findings.recommended_fix: Document any prior code review (even informal, e.g. co-author review of model_fun.R) or explicitly note that this ValidateHE run is the first independent review.

findings.test: AdViSHE C2: extreme-value runs to expose implementation errors
findings.inputs: Grep for 'extreme' across all extracted/reviewed documents (no matches) and AGENTS.md
findings.expected: Documentation records whether extreme-value tests were used to expose implementation errors and where tests/results are reported
findings.observed: No mention of extreme-value / boundary-condition testing (e.g. zero mortality, zero discounting, equalized effectiveness) was found in any reviewed document. test_sim_idx_validation.R exists and is described in AGENTS.md as validating input handling, but it is not framed as extreme-value stress-testing of model behavior.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a documented extreme-value test suite (e.g. zero-discount, zero-mortality, equalized-effectiveness runs) and report results/location in AGENTS.md or a technical_docs report.

findings.test: AdViSHE C3: model traces inspected to test logic
findings.inputs: inventory.md script listing for 09_traces.R; figs/traces_*_state_occupancy.png (per environment.md folder tree); S01 AGENTS.md 'Important Modeling Considerations'
findings.expected: Documentation records whether model traces were inspected to test logic and where the trace evidence is reported
findings.observed: 09_traces.R generates state-occupancy trace plots stored in figs/ (traces_all_strategies_state_occupancy.png etc.), and AGENTS.md separately documents non-negativity (p_p = pmax(os-pfs,0)) and initial-state (p_pf[1]=1) constraints as implementation considerations that traces would reveal violations of. Neither source explicitly frames trace generation/inspection as a validation activity with a stated pass/fail outcome or reviewer-facing report.
findings.location: scripts/R/analysis/09_traces.R; figs/traces_*.png; S01 AGENTS.md 'Ensuring Non-Negative States'
findings.recommended_fix: Add a short paragraph (e.g. in AGENTS.md or a technical_docs report) explicitly stating that trace plots were inspected for the documented non-negativity/initial-state constraints and summarizing the outcome.

findings.test: AdViSHE C4: submodules unit-tested under a predefined protocol
findings.inputs: S01 AGENTS.md 'Test Files' section; inventory.md function list for test_sim_idx_validation.R, compare_snapshots.R
findings.expected: Documentation records whether submodules were unit-tested under a predefined protocol with criteria/acceptance norms and where results are reported
findings.observed: AGENTS.md names and briefly describes 5 test/diagnostic scripts (test_sex_variable_fix.R, compare_snapshots.R, test_psa_error_rate.R, test_sampling_convergence_rate.R, diagnose_prediction_failures.R) plus test_sim_idx_validation.R (visible in inventory.md with expect_error-style assertions). Purpose and location are documented, but no predefined acceptance protocol/thresholds or a summarized pass/fail report is described anywhere.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a short 'Test protocol and results' subsection stating pass/fail criteria for each test script and current status.

findings.test: AdViSHE D1: outputs judged reasonable by qualified experts
findings.inputs: R01 'Parametric survival models' results paragraph; R01 author list (incl. Dept of Oncology co-authors)
findings.expected: Documentation records whether qualified experts judged the model outputs reasonable, who they were, and their conclusion
findings.observed: Manuscript states predicted 5-year OS extrapolations were 'clinically plausible, consistent with published registry data', and lists clinical oncology co-authors including the trial PI, but there is no separate, explicitly-labeled expert-judgment exercise with named reviewers, criteria, and a stated agreement outcome distinct from general manuscript authorship/co-signing.
findings.recommended_fix: Add an explicit statement identifying which co-author(s) reviewed model outputs for clinical plausibility in a formal capacity, distinct from general manuscript co-authorship.

findings.test: AdViSHE D2: outputs compared with other models
findings.inputs: R01 full text (Introduction, Discussion, Research in context)
findings.expected: Documentation records whether model outputs were compared with those of other decision models and where
findings.observed: The manuscript self-describes as 'the first economic evaluation' of biomarker-guided ICB in MSS mCRC and does not compare its own numerical outputs (ICERs, QALYs) against any other published decision model's outputs.
findings.recommended_fix: If no comparator model exists (plausible, given stated novelty), add an explicit sentence stating this rather than leaving the comparison silently absent.

findings.test: AdViSHE D3: outputs compared under alternative input data
findings.inputs: docs_extracted/CEA.txt; S01 AGENTS.md UTILITY_SOURCE row; scenario/biosimilar report entries in documentation_manifest.md
findings.expected: Documentation records whether outputs were compared under alternative input data/assumptions and where
findings.observed: One-way DSA/tornado (OWSA.qmd), scenario analyses incl. biosimilar nivolumab pricing (scenario_effect.qmd, biosimilar_scenario.qmd), and an alternative utility-source toggle (UTILITY_SOURCE 0/1, IPD vs CORRECT trial) are all named with clear report locations and documented purposes.
findings.location: scripts/QMD/report/OWSA.qmd; scenario_effect.qmd; biosimilar_scenario.qmd; S01 AGENTS.md UTILITY_SOURCE row
findings.recommended_fix: None required.

findings.test: AdViSHE D4: outputs compared with empirical data
findings.target: manuscript Results, parametric survival models paragraph
findings.inputs: R01 'Gamma distributions provided the best fit... predicted 5-year OS of 6.1% for standard care under Model A, consistent with published registry data for MSS mCRC (ref 5)'
findings.expected: Documentation records whether outputs were compared with empirical data (dependent or independent), what data type, and where reported
findings.observed: A single narrative sentence compares predicted 5-year OS against a published cancer-statistics registry reference (ref 5, Siegel et al 2025) with no quantified agreement statistic, no explicit dependent-vs-independent classification, and no dedicated validation section or reproducible location beyond the prose sentence itself.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a short external/empirical validation subsection (even brief) quantifying the comparison (e.g. predicted vs registry 5-year OS with a stated tolerance) and classifying it as dependent or independent validation.

findings.test: AdViSHE E1: other validation techniques
findings.inputs: All reviewed materials
findings.expected: Documentation records any additional validation techniques used and where applied/reported, or explicitly notes none were used
findings.observed: No additional validation techniques beyond those captured in A1-D4 were found or claimed; the corpus does not explicitly state that no further techniques were applied.
findings.recommended_fix: Optional: add a closing sentence noting no additional validation techniques beyond those described were applied, for completeness.

findings.test: CDA-AMC 26: deterministic/single-simulation results accessible
findings.inputs: docs_extracted/CEA.txt sections 3-4; S01 AGENTS.md run_basecase()/10_basecase_analysis.R
findings.expected: Deterministic/single-run results are clearly separated from probabilistic results and accessible in reviewer-usable terms
findings.observed: CEA.qmd Section 3 'Base Case Results' (deterministic, WTP=EUR51,000) is explicitly separated from Section 4 'Probabilistic Sensitivity Analysis'; AGENTS.md and inventory.md trace this to run_basecase()/10_basecase_analysis.R.
findings.recommended_fix: None required.

findings.test: CDA-AMC 27: inputs traceable through to final outcomes
findings.inputs: S01 AGENTS.md 'Key Functions' section; inventory.md dependency graph (model_configs.R -> model_fun.R -> calculate_outcomes.R)
findings.expected: A reviewer can trace from named input parameters through to final outputs using the documentation alone
findings.observed: AGENTS.md documents the function chain (get_current_model_config -> model_fun -> calculate_outcomes) and names the central parameter object (l_params_base, built at 07_basecase_input_parameters.R:51); inventory.md's parsed call graph corroborates this path. However, no single consolidated traceability table/diagram maps each specific input parameter to the specific output(s) it feeds; the trace must be reconstructed from source comments plus AGENTS.md prose across multiple files.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a single input-to-output traceability diagram or table (e.g. in AGENTS.md or a technical_docs report) explicitly linking each l_params_base field to the model_fun()/calculate_outcomes() steps that consume it.

findings.test: R-equivalent of CDA-AMC 53: inputs centralized and transparently documented
findings.inputs: S01 AGENTS.md model_configs.R description and UTILITY_SOURCE table (default 0); docs_extracted/input_parameters.txt Table 3 (u_np=0.730, u_p=0.590, i.e. UTILITY_SOURCE=1 rendered); environment.md globals
findings.expected: Inputs affecting results are documented as centralized in one place, and that documentation is current/consistent
findings.observed: model_configs.R is explicitly documented as the 'single source of truth' for strategies/biomarkers/formulas (AGENTS.md, model_b_comparison.qmd), and input_parameters.qmd consolidates all cost/utility/structural inputs into one reviewer-facing table -- strong centralization. However, AGENTS.md's own parameter table states the UTILITY_SOURCE default is 0 (IPD-derived, u_np=0.9077/u_p=0.9005), while the currently-rendered input_parameters.qmd (v4.0, 2026-06-18) reports the CORRECT-trial values (u_np=0.730/u_p=0.590) as the base case -- i.e. UTILITY_SOURCE=1 is what actually renders. The documentation does not flag or explain this discrepancy.
findings.location: S01 AGENTS.md 'Critical Global Variables' table (UTILITY_SOURCE row); docs_extracted/input_parameters.txt Table 3
findings.recommended_fix: Correct AGENTS.md's UTILITY_SOURCE default value (or correct the code/re-render input_parameters.qmd) so the documented default and the currently-rendered base case agree, and state explicitly which utility source is the manuscript's primary base case.
